Controls

Stick (bottom-left) — pitch / roll. Drag, release to centre.
Throttle (left slider) — Shift / Ctrl or ↑ / ↓ on keyboard.
Flaps / Airbrake / Vector — right panel sliders. Vector only on the F-35A: at 90° the throttle becomes lift — hover, then descend under 4 m/s onto a VTOL pad.
Gear G · Hook H · Brake hold B · Flare F · Fire gun hold Space · Missile M (needs lock — hold the target in the 15° cone, listen for the tone).
Camera C — Chase / Cockpit / Free orbit (drag to orbit, pinch to zoom in Free). R resets the camera.
Pause P · Restart ↻ button.
Carrier trap: hook down, under 140 kt over the stern wires — the wire catches you. Over that speed it snaps.
Stall: below stall speed the wing drops and the nose falls — push the nose down and add power to recover.
Damage: wing hits roll you, engine hits cost thrust. Smoke under 60%, fire under 35%.
Minimap: green = runways, blue = helicarrier, red diamonds = enemies, grey = traffic, white = you.
